adjudication.rationale: The diff adds Admin::EmbeddableHostsController with update/destroy actions that do `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then immediately call `save_host(host)` / `host.destroy` without handling `host == nil`. If an unknown id is passed, `save_host` will raise (e.g., `host.host = ...` on nil) and `destroy` will also raise, causing a 500 instead of a controlled 404/JSON error. The spec file mentioned indeed only asserts inheritance and does not exercise create/update/destroy or the `save_host` branches (uncategorized fallback, error rendering, serializer output), so this behavior is untested as well.
